comparisons.peer_topic: Interest income and gain/loss recognition for debt securities
comparisons.peer_summary: Interest on debt securities, including premium amortization and discount accretion, is included in interest income using the constant effective yield method. Realized gains and losses from sales or dispositions are determined using the specific identification method.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and BAC disclose the treatment of discount accretion within interest income. JPM specifies that its interest income includes accretion related to First Republic acquisitions, while BAC provides a general accounting policy stating that interest on debt securities includes the accretion of discounts calculated using the constant effective yield method.

sentences.text: (d)Includes the accretion of the purchase discount on certain acquired loans and investment securities associated with First Republic.
Interest on debt securities, including amortization of premiums and accretion of discounts, is included in interest income.
Premiums and discounts are amortized or accreted to interest income at a constant effective yield over the contractual lives of the securities.
